cohort: Pregnant women giving birth to singleton pregnancies: 290 conceived by oocyte donation, 290 conceived by homologous gametes and 870 by spontaneous conception
finding: Singleton pregnancies by oocyte donation are associated with an increased risk of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and postpartum haemorrhage compared to pregnancies conceived by homologous gametes.
mod_finding: The risk of caesarean section was higher in singleton pregnancies by oocyte donation compared to both other groups.
